task: Independent source-only review of live server-port integration
result: No concrete production defect found within the requested change boundary.

observations.subject: Exact binding before publication
observations.conclusion: Foreign attachment wrapper binds view.configuration.server_port before invoking native Owner factory. Context initialization later uses the same reference. RuntimeOwner first moves configuration into nonmovable owner, then bind_state invokes passive factory; publish/hooks occur later. Bind stores only pointer under metadata lock, no scalar value or persistent atomic_ref, preserving later startup parser assignments.

observations.subject: Absent/mismatched cell
observations.conclusion: AdmissionLease passes Context.network.server_port_0a3c90 explicitly. Original Domain compares its address against once-bound pointer before incrementing calls or loading scalar. Missing/mismatched cell throws before body/wait/SDK permission.

observations.subject: All reviewed live scalar conflicts
observations.conclusion: Every production live scalar load/store found by bounded server_port/port_0a3c90/server_port_0a3c90 search now uses transient relaxed atomic_ref<uint16_t>. Lock-free and required-alignment static assertions are present. Reference forwarding/address comparison sites do not load scalar values. Separate startup publication snapshot is not this cell.

observations.subject: Remaining plain startup assignments
observations.conclusion: Parser writes remain plain before worker/hooks in the selected startup order; binding does not retain atomic_ref. State and RuntimeOwner accessor document stable-cell lifetime and quiescence for plain accesses/copies. External concurrent raw field access remains outside reviewed source contract.

observations.subject: Native branch order
observations.conclusion: Original web80/443 compares live word immediately after successful hook receipt; no Server milestone or fallback. Nonweb admission grants wait without reading shared word; complete_wait runs after actual recovered wait.3216 short-circuits scalar comparison and enters redirect. Other nonweb compares only after wait. Core path has equivalent short-circuit order.

observations.subject: Separate log/final loads and no rollback
observations.conclusion: Original redirect receives exact live Context cell, not local snapshot. Body loads live port for log after two literal insertions/requested-port insertion, then flushes and updates cached counter. Terminal15 dialog/exit precedes final rewrite. Nonterminal performs distinct late port reread. Completion checks actor/publication/poison only and does not undo earlier route because scalar changed.

observations.subject: Server capture/store/export
observations.conclusion: Input capture follows context initialization and precedes address parsing. Actual bound port uses relaxed store before environment export and startup completion. Cached bound_port feeds environment/publication, matching native use of AX after shared store and avoiding accidental shared rereads.

observations.subject: Actor/scope preservation
observations.conclusion: Existing TLS actor/fiber ownership and phase-specific permissions remain: Waiting grants wait only, Redirect grants narrow network effects, Original grants SDK only. Live scalar availability does not grant general callback/allocator/registry/private recovered PTD permission. Same-thread reentry and other forbidden scopes remain rejected.

observations.subject: Exception/count/LastError safety
observations.conclusion: Binding/admission/completion bookkeeping restores incoming WinLastError. Failed exact-cell checks own no count; failed initial reservation clears TLS/count. Completion exceptions leave admitted actor for existing AdmissionLease destructor to release; provider unknown exceptions retain poison. Native Context lease remains through admission leave. Final body/SDK error state is preserved around metadata cleanup. Existing no-fiber-migration and provider contracts were not broadened.

observations.subject: Original/Cooperative separation
observations.conclusion: Original constructor rejects Cooperative proof/snapshot mixture; assembly supplies only per-hook publication and passively binds exact cell. Cooperative keeps its separate immutable milestone/snapshot behavior. No new milestone/equality gate was introduced in Original route.

limitations: Source inspection only. No compilation, linking, project tests or target execution verifies emitted code or runtime schedules.
Native references are previously retained complete structured replies from root and peer; this reviewer did not rerun native analysis or change any REA session.

Search is bounded to production outputs C++ headers/sources, excluding tests/fixtures; unknown downstream aliases, raw field access, overlapping copies/writes, or injected providers are outside this review.
Ordinary startup parser writes remain valid under the documented before-workers/hooks ordering; external reconfiguration or copying a live State requires synchronization/quiescence.
This result covers live-port integration; it is not a new general callback reentry or CRT concurrency claim.
